displayName: Certutil Abuse for Remote File Download or Decoding

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName =~ "certutil.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-urlcache", "/urlcache", "-verifyctl", "/verifyctl", "-decode", "/decode", "-decodehex")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("http://", "https://", "ftp://", ".exe", ".dll", ".ps1", ".bat", ".vbs")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, ReportId

alertTemplate.title: Certutil Abuse for Remote File Download or Decoding
alertTemplate.description: Detects certutil.exe invoked with urlcache, split or decode flags to retrieve remote payloads or decode staged files, a living off the land technique detailed in ASD/ACSC joint guidance. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-0843, ISM-1405, ISM-1621. Advisories: acsc-2024-02-07-identifying-and-mitigating-living-off-the-land-techniques.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Inspect the downloaded URL or decoded output file, verify parent process activity, and quarantine any unauthorised binaries staged by certutil (ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-0843, ISM-1405, ISM-1621; Advisories: acsc-2024-02-07-identifying-and-mitigating-living-off-the-land-techniques).
